title: senecio altaicus
intro: Senecio altaicus, commonly known as Golden Groundsel, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio altaicus include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of coughs, colds, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Senecio altaicus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
